digest.component_or_area: Live DC Harness / Jira Reconciler Output Parsing
propositions: Test assertions in test_reconcile_pass.py check for 'OK:' in stdout, but the sync route suppresses OK: output per __main__.py:437 route gate and documented contract
The canonical sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr and RECON telemetry lines (outbound/inbound differ totals and batch_outcome mutations) instead of stdout OK: summary

Zero-write idempotence assertion cannot rely on BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone because that signal is emitted regardless of mutations applied; it requires both differ totals to be zero and zero batch_outcome lines

Two failing DC harness cells (test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing and test_a_dc_created_ticket_carries_the_shared_jira_provenance) need refactored assertions to parse the correct stderr signals the sync route actually emits
Parsing logic must be unit-testable in isolation via a new dependency-free module _bridge_output.py so the fix is provable without live Jira and credentials
